text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both in retreat, with BTC down 5.9% and ETH down 5.0% over 24 hours, signaling coordinated weakness across the two majors. The Fear & Greed index at 20 (Extreme Fear) and deteriorating by 8 points over a week reflects sustained pessimism despite relatively modest intraday volume of $94B. Bitcoin's dominance near 59% suggests capital is rotating into altcoins or exiting markets entirely rather than flowing to safer major assets.
